change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Mobile small-action offsets still assume the old 4em left padding
findings.body: `.small-action-desc` used to have `padding: 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em`. The avatar was floated, so the text sat to its right. This change makes `.small-action` a flex row and sets the padding to `0 1.5%`. The mobile overrides were not updated: `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:520-522` still sets `.small-action-desc .custom-message { margin-left: -40px }`, and `:530-532` still sets `.small-action.time-gap .topic-avatar { margin-top: -5px }`. Both values compensated for the old padding and the old vertical spacing. The desc is now a flex item next to the avatar, and the avatar has `padding: 0` on mobile (`mobile/topic-post.scss:525-528`). So the -40px margin should pull the custom message left into the icon, since the desc has no more left padding to absorb it. The -5px time-gap offset should also push that row off-centre now that `align-items: center` sets the vertical alignment. I could not render this, so I am inferring the overlap from the CSS. Check the mobile layout for small actions that carry a custom message, and for time-gaps. Remove or recompute both mobile overrides.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin passes the standard value to legacy properties that use a different vocabulary
findings.body: The mixin writes `$alignment` unchanged into `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`. Those legacy properties accept `start|end|center|baseline|stretch`, not `flex-start|flex-end`. It works for the two values used here (`center`, `baseline`). Anyone who later calls `align-items(flex-start)` gets invalid declarations in those engines, with no warning. `-ms-align-items` (line 121) is not a real property, and line 120 has trailing whitespace. Map `flex-start` and `flex-end` to `start` and `end` for the legacy properties, or document that the mixin only supports `center` and `baseline`. Drop `-ms-align-items`. The same applies to `order` at line 125 if it is ever called with 0 or a negative value, because the 2009 `box-ordinal-group` property starts at 1.

findings.title: Header panel is now a shrinkable flex item that holds floated icons
findings.body: The `.panel` used to float right. It is now a flex item with `margin-left: auto`, and its children (`.icons`, the `li`s and the login buttons) are still floats. A flex item's automatic minimum width is its min-content width, and the min-content width of a container of floats can be as small as the widest single float. On a narrow viewport, with the topic title in `.extra-info-wrapper` competing for space, the panel may shrink and wrap the icons onto a second row. Previously the float simply overflowed or was clipped. Consider `flex-shrink: 0` on `.panel`, or `white-space: nowrap`, and check the header at around 320–570px with a logged-in user and the docked topic title shown.

summary: This is a CSS-only change that moves the header contents and `.small-action` to flexbox through new vendor-prefix mixins. I found one likely regression: mobile small actions with a custom message, where the old `-40px` margin may now overlap the avatar. I also found a weak mixin contract and a possible panel-shrink issue on narrow headers. The header ordering, `.title` removal and badge changes looked consistent in the files I read. I could not render anything, so the layout points are inferred from the CSS.
